method.name: readWithHistory
method.signature: readWithHistory(id: string): Promise<Artifact<unknown> & { changeLog: ChangeLogEntry[]; feedback: Feedback[] }>
method.purpose: A read that exposes the artifact together with its change log and feedback in one shape, as DEF ac4 requires; read stays the cheap head-only read.

rationale: DEF ac4 says a read exposes a change log, feedback and a lifecycle in one shape, but the sc2 Artifact omits the change log and feedback. A second read method is additive and keeps read cheap for callers that need only the head (the performance sentence in the HLD).
